This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their hunched posture, [[Color|brown]] and pink skin, thick tails covered in stubby spines, and mouths featuring four fleshy, tube-like protrusions.<ref name="TFA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Takodana Castle]] when the [[First Order]] destroyed the [[Hosnian system]] and invaded the planet [[Takodana]] in search of the [[droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[2015]] film {{Film|VII}}, directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TFA" /> They were originally designed by concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]],<ref name="JLD">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/ClkDx8SqWaN/|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2022-11-29|quote=Background alien design for The Force Awakens - he was blasting his way out of the ruins of Max’s castle but never made the cut. ➡️2️⃣ pic of same guy from @phil_szostak Art of TFA book ➡️3️⃣4️⃣5️⃣ behind the scenes stills and screengrabs from 360° Creature Shop on Starwars.com. #starwars #theforceawakens #conceptdesign #creaturedesign #creatureshop #creatureconcept #alien #starwarscreatures #bountyhunter #bts #behindthescenes|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/QcGPX}}</ref> and were referred to by the production code "C079."<ref name="C079">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/BUHcsNLFzOi/|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2017-05-15|quote=Another Force Awakens creature that never made it in the final cut. Poor old C079. He was this cool little bounty hunter hanging out at Maz's castle. He came out fighting but I guess he got trapped in the rubble. #starwars #theforceawakens #forceawakens #alien #creature #conceptdesign #bountyhunter|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/rmP0z}}</ref>
